name: Single 2D Projection Voxelization
definition: An algorithm that produces 6-separating voxelization using only one 2D projection along the dominant axis of the triangle's normal vector, leveraging the thinness property.
summary: Single 2D Projection Voxelization generates tunnel-free voxelizations of planar triangles using one rasterization pass along the dominant axis, reducing computational overhead compared to multi-view methods.
